description: For griffin.com. Unofficial .NET client for Griffin banking-as-a-service: onboarding (legal persons, claims, verifications), bank accounts, payees, payments, transactions, events, verified webhooks and request signing.
releaseNotes:
v1.2.2:
- FIXED: Webhook.verify answers Expired for an expires outside the dates .NET holds, instead of throwing

v1.2.1:
- FIXED: StandingOrder.payAsync fails instead of paying again when the payments lookup answers without its list, when unsent copies of a reference are ambiguous, or when the reference belongs to a payment of another amount
- FIXED: StandingOrder.payAsync prefers a submitted copy of a reference, and validate refuses a reference that starts or ends with a space
- FIXED: StandingOrder.occurrences, nextDue and dueOccurrences refuse a frequency that never moves on, instead of hanging
- FIXED: StandingOrder.payAsync's lookup reaches a payment whose due date has moved since
- CHANGED: Page.Unparsed holds an entry when a list answer lacks its list
- ADDED: Api.Query (GriffinQuery in C#) spells page size, sort and filters for withQuery
v1.2.0:
- ADDED: GriffinClient.createHttpClient: an HttpClient that doesn't follow redirects, which would send signatures and bodies to the redirect's host
- ADDED: StandingOrder: schedules, due dates and paying an occurrence safely, for the caller's job to run (Griffin has no standing orders)
- ADDED: PaymentRefusal.ofFailure reads why a payment was refused; BankProduct.Schemes; Api.attachCopToPayeeAsync
- ADDED: users, roles, memberships, invitations and API keys, with a new key's secret hidden when printed
- ADDED: reliance onboarding applications and their events
- ADDED: legal person history, verification profiles, get workflow, get bank product
- ADDED: Api.openAccountAsync opens an account by kind; Api.updateRestrictionAsync; Api.rejectPaymentAsync
- ADDED: Api.getWebhookTestStatusAsync, Api.verifyRequestSignatureAsync, verification resource and test events
- ADDED: Submission.ScheduledAt and UniqueSchemeIdentifier; Payment.PaymentType, MandateUrl, AdmissionsUrl, RejectionReason, RejectedAt; BankProduct.NoticePeriod
- ADDED: BankAccount.SavingsType, ClientMoneyType, PrimaryAccount, AccruedInterest, ControllerUrl, OpenedAt, ClosedAt; Transaction.ProcessedAt; LegalPerson.LegalName, StatusChangedAt, HistoryUrl
v1.1.0:
- ADDED: Ed25519Key.signerOf: a request signer from a PKCS#8 private key, as PEM in any layout or bare base64
- ADDED: dependency on BouncyCastle.Cryptography, for Ed25519 on every target
v1.0.0:
- ADDED: navigation (index, organization), bank products, workflows
- ADDED: legal persons (create, get, list, rename), claims (Claims module; list, add, delete), verifications, IDV check links, decisions, manual decisions
- ADDED: bank accounts (open, get, list, close), restrictions (freeze, block, lift), statements (request, get, download), Direct Debit mandates (list, get, cancel)
- ADDED: Confirmation of Payee and its sandbox simulation, payees (create, get, list, deactivate), payments (create, submit, submissions), admissions, transactions
- ADDED: events with typed payloads, webhook management, webhook verification (ES512) with Webhook.KeyCache
- ADDED: RFC 9421 request signing through a pluggable RequestSigner (Ed25519, required in live mode)
- ADDED: Api.sendAsync / sendRawAsync for any endpoint, Api.downloadAsync, Api.allPagesAsync for pagination
- ADDED: DUs with Other for Griffin's closed value sets; UkAccount with validation; InvalidRequest before sending
- ADDED: Page.Unparsed keeps unreadable list items; WebhookRejection says why a delivery failed; KeyCache keeps its keys when a refresh fails
- ADDED: for C#: GriffinConfig.Create, Money.Gbp, RequestSigner.Create, WebhookRequest.Create, GriffinApi.AllPagesAsync / WithQuery, GetValueOrThrow(Async) with GriffinException
- ADDED: GriffinFailure.describe; list parameters (claims, country codes, query pairs) take any sequence
- ADDED: searches (legal persons, bank accounts, payments), account rename, webhook update, Companies House lookup
- ADDED: card holds, pooled account membership, tell.money open banking consents, Claims.verifiedBankAccount
